clauses.quote: Unit members who were "grandfathered" under the LDS program in 1984 will receive a stipend of 1%.

clauses.quote: Unit members working in assignments identified by the District as "preferring/requiring" a Bilingual/ELD certification/LEP authorization (BCC, BCLAD, LDS, CLAD, SB 1969/395 SDAIE, or SB 1969/395 ELD/SDAIE) shall receive the appropriate stipend as in section 7.7.7.3 above.
